cand.title: OENOVITI International Symposium and General Assembly 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong event evidence and a credible hospitality mechanism; current-edition accessibility is reduced by venue commitment or unresolved sourcing.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified commercially relevant organizer-side contacts: Agathe Lairy, University of Bordeaux / ISVV project manager, and Professor Pierre-Louis Teissedre, Head / Coordinator of OENOVITI International. The university foundation names both; the official 2026 programme lists them in the network contact team. Agathe is the practical coordination/referral entry point; Pierre-Louis is the senior network relationship contact. Relevance to a lodging introduction is an inference from these roles and the Coordination Office mandate. Neither is verified as the 2027 hotel contracting authority.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: 19–21 May 2027, Nyon, Switzerland, hosted by Changins and Agroscope. Theme: Viticulture 2030: Addressing environmental, social and human challenges. These are activity dates, independently stated by OENOVITI and the Agroscope event calendar, not article dates. Within the requested horizon. Agroscope states registration opens 1 December 2026. No officially announced 2028 edition was located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specification: credible geographically for accommodation supporting a Nyon academic conference, not a downtown-Geneva megashow or resort retreat. YOTEL’s 237 rooms and stated 20–120-room commercial band could support a partial group if demand is established, but no block size is justified today. The 2026 edition reported 97 participants, suggesting a potentially compatible scale only; it is not a 2027 forecast or room count. The six meeting rooms / approximately 250-theatre maximum are not a reason to pursue displacement of the confirmed Changins venue. Optional small working-group meetings or F&B are speculative and require organizer demand confirmation. Transfers from Founex to the event and the B&B departure point would need agreement.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue: Changins | Haute école de viticulture et œnologie / University of Applied Sciences Changins, Route de Duillier 52, 1260 Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland. In the Nyon / La Côte primary territory, not Geneva city or Lausanne. Agroscope explicitly lists Location: Changins. Exact auditorium and session-by-session locations remain unverified; the linked programme document could not be retrieved. This is a published venue selection, not evidence of a reviewed venue contract. Changins is an educational institution, not a competing hotel.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified recent sequence: 14–15 May 2024, Asti, Italy, Asti University Campus—Uni-Astiss / Polo Universitario Rita Levi Montalcini, hosted by University of Turin; 22–23 May 2025, Vienna, Austria, hosted by BOKU, with activities in Tulln; 20–22 May 2026, Porto, Portugal, Faculty of Sciences of University of Porto, Ferreira da Silva Auditorium; 19–21 May 2027, Changins, Nyon, Switzerland. Official series text explicitly describes annual events. International rotation is demonstrated, but annual return to Switzerland is not.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Participant self-booking with an edition-specific recommended hotel, not a published centralized housing bureau or open RFP. OENOVITI: “OENOVITI Members will need to make their own accommodation bookings”; “We recommend booking your accommodation at Hôtel B&B NYON - 20 Allée de la Petite Prairie, 1260 Nyon”; “Activities will depart and return to this location.” Corporate code: NOVITI27. Agroscope explicitly adds: “You are, of course, free to choose alternative accommodation to suit your needs.” Hôtel B&B NYON is the only hotel named in the reviewed 2027 official materials. No allocated room count, guaranteed block, rate, release date or exclusivity was published. This is a recommendation and logistics anchor, not proof of committed lodging inventory.
findings.organizationStructure: Academic–industry viticulture/oenology research and training network, rather than a corporate celebration organizer. OENOVITI is administered by an Executive Committee; its Bordeaux/ISVV Coordination Office is explicitly the main contact for event organization. ADERA collects membership fees, manages network finances and supports project management; it is not thereby established as the hotel buyer or a PCO. Changins and Agroscope are the named Swiss co-organizers/hosts. No appointed PCO, DMC or housing bureau was identified in the reviewed edition materials.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Hôtel B&B NYON has a material incumbent advantage: edition-specific recommendation, participant identification code and departure/return location for activities. Alternative lodging is expressly permitted, so exclusivity cannot be claimed. No sell-out, overflow requirement, unmet rooms or YOTEL booking/transfer arrangement was found. Neither the whole 237-room house nor a 120-room peak block is supported by published demand.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Before registration opens on 1 December 2026, approach Agathe Lairy through the published network team address, copying or seeking referral from Pierre-Louis Teissedre. Acknowledge Changins as venue and B&B NYON as the recommended logistics hotel. Ask whether YOTEL may be offered as an optional participant-booked alternative, who coordinates the Swiss accommodation recommendations, and whether a supplementary hotel can be integrated with activity departures. Request 2027 expected nonlocal attendance, stay dates and any actual unmet demand before discussing a modest allocation/rate. Do not send an assumed room-block RFP or propose moving the symposium. If no supplementary need exists, retain a host/network relationship rather than presenting this as open group business.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 conference venue is selected; primary meeting capture is not an evidenced opportunity. Lodging remains participant-booked and alternatives are explicitly allowed, but hotel sourcing is not confirmed open and no organizer-purchased block is evidenced. A limited alternative-accommodation/referral proposal is accessible in principle, subject to organizer acceptance and workable transfers. Registration opening on 1 December 2026 provides a relevant outreach milestone, not a procurement deadline.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: prioritize relationship with the Swiss hosts and OENOVITI Coordination Office for any 2027 accommodation supplement and genuinely local future workshops. The annual internationally rotating series does not create an annual Nyon hotel opportunity. No announced Swiss return or 2028 local edition was found; do not create future local dates or treat later editions as available to YOTEL.
